headline: 川普再度逼退庫克
context: 美國最高法院日前裁定聯準會（Federal Reserve）具有獨立性，但川普政府仍再度出手，試圖解僱聯準會理事麗莎・庫克（Lisa Cook），理由是她涉嫌房貸詐欺。白宮已經去信庫克，表示「正在考慮」將她免職。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: White House continues to target Cook despite decision from justices that upheld Federal Reserve’s independence Donald Trump is attempting once again to oust the US Federal Reserve governor Lisa Cook over allegations of mortgage fraud, despite a recent US supreme court decision that upheld the central bank’s independence. Cook reportedly received a letter from the White House this week that provided notice, in accordance to the supreme court’s June ruling, that Trump was “considering removing” her from her Fed position over the same claims of mortgage fraud that he levied against her last summer. sources.title: Trump renews bid to fire Fed governor Lisa Cook despite supreme court ruling

sources.name: The New York Times
sources.summary: The Trump administration, rebuffed by the Supreme Court in its first attempt to fire Lisa D. Cook, sent the Federal Reserve governor a letter saying it was “considering” removing her from the job.
sources.title: Trump Restarts Battle to Fire Sitting Fed Governor Lisa Cook

📌 全球經濟趨勢

川普再度出手，要解僱聯準會理事庫克

美國最高法院日前裁定聯準會具有獨立性，但川普政府仍再度出手，試圖解僱聯準會理事麗莎・庫克，理由是她涉嫌房貸詐欺。白宮已經去信庫克，表示「正在考慮」將她免職。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian、The New York Times 於 2026 年 8 月 8 日發佈的報導，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

川普再度出手，要解僱聯準會理事庫克。

美國最高法院日前裁定聯準會（Federal Reserve）具有獨立性，但川普政府仍再度出手，試圖解僱聯準會理事麗莎・庫克（Lisa Cook），理由是她涉嫌房貸詐欺。白宮已經去信庫克，表示「正在考慮」將她免職。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 8 月 8 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 美國最高法院之前才裁定，聯準會具有獨立性。但川普政府不死心，再度試圖解僱聯準會理事麗莎・庫克，理由是她涉嫌房貸詐欺。白宮已經去信給她，說「正在考慮」將她免職。
